title: Instruction precondition holds universally
statement: For every bit string $x$ and every configuration of the seven-register program, the selected instruction satisfies its precondition: register comparisons use distinct registers, input-word comparisons are made only on inputs with the required valid encoding, and oracle calls use pairwise distinct argument registers.
hypotheses_covered: The configuration is an abstract configuration with seven natural-number registers and an optional program state and result
replaced:
For every bit string $x$ and every configuration of the fixed seven-register program,
the instruction selected by the program satisfies its precondition: any register
comparison uses distinct registers, any input-word comparison has the required valid
input encoding, and any oracle call uses a list of distinct argument registers.
